name: API token as a Basic credential, being retired
description: The Zendesk API token sent as the password of a Basic credential whose username is {email_address}/token, as Zendesk documents it while retiring it in three dated phases (2026-07-28, 2026-10-27, 2027-04-30). This variant records the lifecycle state, not a different token format: the pages state no format difference between eras.

history.note: The migration page captured on 2026-09-24 gives the three-phase schedule ending with final deactivation on 2027-04-30. The Security and authentication page captured on 2026-04-21 still recommended API tokens and did not label them deprecated. The announcement date is not on the pages read, so no occurredAt is recorded; the effective period is left open because the final date is planned and has not yet occurred.

sources.supports: Zendesk is retiring Support API tokens in three phases between July 2026 and April 2027. ... April 30, 2027 Phase 3: Final deactivation. All remaining API tokens will be permanently deactivated.

You can authorize against the API using your email address and an API token, or with an OAuth access token. ... Zendesk recommends switching your authentication method to API tokens or OAuth tokens for improved security.

notes: Project-authored by the Redact Secret project, which maintains this repository; not independent evidence. Draft; not yet reviewed.
